reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that shows a named lab and a batch report I can check against the box. Bisglycinate with no oxide and a stated 200 mg dose is what I look for, and $24.99 for the first box is fair enough to try one.
objection: It is made in China and I have not opened the lab report yet. If the report does not match the label or the lab turns out to be unknown, I will not reorder. At $29.99 it is also pricier than Toplux or Goli.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch was missing or did not match the batch number on the box, I would not buy.
